2.text: You began your journey on a dock leading to a collection of intertwined wooden platforms. Their stability was questionable but you had to navigate them to complete your pilgrimage.

3.text: You climbed the ramped staircase slippery with moss barely being able to see where you'd go next.

choices.text: You chose the straight path continuing forward ignoring the alternative and somewhat questionable path to your right.
choices.label: Continue this way

choices.text: You chose the bent path to the right ignoring the simpler path forward.
choices.label: Continue this way

5.text: This path seemed tretcherous but you already made your decision. Although risky this way filled you with excitment.

6.text: You turned the corner, looked down and saw a path tilted, broken and sinking. You felt that your decision has been made and you must continue.

7.text: You stumbled across the decaying path, slipping and sliding before making it to the final hurdle, a gap. You jumped to the much more secure rock in front of you.

choices.text: You made the jump safely but now another decision. You chose the path heading downwards. You found comfort in being closer to the murky water below.
choices.label: Continue this way

choices.text: You made the jump safely but now another decision. You chose the path that seemed simple as your last decision made you cautious.
choices.label: Continue this way

9.text: You turned the first corner but before you did you looked out into the nothingness of your surroundings. You didn't know whether you felt fear or excitment.

10.text: You turned the next corner and found yourself under a tree in which you heard rustling above. You were to afraid to look up so you continued forward.

11.text: This path seemed safe. You had steady footing but you worried that this path is too good to be true. You continued forward anyway

choices.text: Another decision to make. You chose left. Looking ahead both paths seemed to lead to the same place but your instincts led you this way.
choices.label: Continue this way

choices.text: Another decision to make. You chose right. Looking ahead both paths seemed to lead to the same place but your instincts led you this way.
choices.label: Continue this way

13.text: You turned the corner and realised you were approaching yet another decision. This path wasn't as simple as it first looked.

choices.text: You chose to continue forward making you last decision pointless however, you felt comfort in that.
choices.label: Continue this way

choices.text: You chose to take the right which leads to a mossy rock. This made your last decision feel worth it.
choices.label: Continue this way

15.text: You continued forward and start to notice that these paths led to the mouth of a cave. You wondered if thats where you're supposed to go.

16.text: The closer you got to the mouth of the cave the more anxiety you felt. You're not sure if this was fear or excitment.

17.text: You're only a few steps from the entrance and as you took each one an overwhelming feeling of completion grew within you.

18.text: The cave was calling your name. Your speed increased with excitment as you couldn't wait to discover what lay inside.

19.text: You were there, at the mouth of the cave. You took a break finally on solid land and contimplated your next steps.

20.text: This path felt solid and simple yet you're not sure if this was the right direction to take.

21.text: You approached a corner with no railings and a rush of fear hits you. One slip on the moss and you're in. You felt that you must stick with your decision go for it.

22.text: This decision led you to a large mossy stone in which multiple paths led. You felt overwhelmed with decision but you waited to make up your mind until you reach the solid land.

23.text: Although this rock had multiple paths you see a cave in the distance and know this is the path you must take.

24.text: You realised this decision leads to a path in which your feet will get wet. The path was balancing on the water and you worried for your safety but continue anyway.

25.text: Although not the longest path it felt so. You tried to be cautious as to not miss a step and risk your life.

26.text: Although you knew this was the path you must take, as you approach you saw its decay and start to doubt yourself. You pushed forward regardless.

27.text: You made it acoss the suprisingly stable titled paths and reach an incline over another large rock. The rock obscured your view but you had faith in your decision.

28.text: As you reached the sumit you were relived by a seemingly secure and simple path ahead leading directly to the mouth of the cave.

29.text: You were now fully within the tree canopy. Unidentifiable fruit hanged down but you batted it away to continue on your journey.

30.text: You made it through the canopy and as you pushed the last leaves away you see that the path ahead has been damaged by a floating log. You chose to cross the log as a makeshift bridge as it seemed to be lodged.

choices.text: The log didn't move and you made it safely across. You chose to take a left as it seems to bring you closer to a solid piece of land and that log has made you weary.
choices.label: Continue this way

choices.text: The log didn't move and you made it safely across. You chose to take a right as this path seems fully visible and you didn't want anymore suprises.
choices.label: Continue this way

32.text: You were right and this path led directly to solid ground. A mossy rock with several paths leading to and from it.

33.text: This path felt relaxing. It was absent of risk and decision. You felt that you have nearly reached your goal.

34.text: As you continued you felt calmer and calmer but were aware that calmness can cause recklessness so you stayed vigilant. The cave mouth you felt holds your goal peaked in the distance.

35.text: Although not there yet you felt proud of your journey. You felt acomplished as well as relieved.

36.text: The last hurdle. A slight incline leading to the mouth of the cave. You were extra careful as to fail at the last hurdle would have destry your spirit.

37.text: You reached the mouth of the cave. You had no doubts and continued forward.
37.note: Current final image — placeholder for offering/ending screen once built out.

38.text: Your carefulness paid off and you were one step away from solid ground. You lunged forward and make it to an intersection of multiple paths.
